proposal.summary: The Optoma 1080PSTX firmware C02 web interface can be accessed without authentication by setting the 'atop' cookie to '1', allowing an attacker on the same network to bypass the login.
proposal.cwe_quote: an attacker, on the same network, can bypass it by manually setting the "atop" cookie to the value of "1".

C.quote: By default the web interface of the 1080PSTX requires a username and password to access the application control panel.  However, an attacker, on the same network, can bypass it by manually setting the "atop" cookie to the value of "1".

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm reproducibility on a device: attempt to access /index.asp without valid credentials both with and without atop=1 cookie; identify all functions exposed post-bypass and determine whether administrative privileges are granted. Collect additional request/response evidence to refine impact and CVSS metrics.
